text:
mira: Heads up — macOS smoke on master hitting a deterministic failure during link: missing generated stamp file for objc stubs. CI started failing ~5m ago.
sam: repro locally with `./dev/build macos-smoke` for me. error looks like cmake didn't emit the stamp into the expected dir.
kyle: can you paste the exact linker error + the last few lines of the cmake/ninja output?
mira: sure — snippet below:
```
[100%] Linking CXX shared library libredwood_core.dylib
ld: file not found: /workspace/build/gen/objc_stubs.stamp
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.
```
alexa: I noticed a CMakeLists change in the last merge: `add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${OUT}/objc_stubs.stamp ... )` was moved under a different directory scope. Could be the OUTPUT path no longer matches the `target_sources` glue.
sam: ah — we recently switched the gen output base from `${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/gen` to `${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated` in a refactor. CI still expects `build/gen/*` from older targets.
kyle: that matches. Quick triage: create a compatibility symlink in CI container or update the CMake to set the stamp path to the canonical gen dir.
eng-oncall-bot: @build-oncall requested — rerun queued (ci:rerun smoke-macos) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mira: quick workaround pushed in CI job: `mkdir -p build/gen && ln -s build/generated/* build/gen/` — unblocks current deploy but we need the real fix.
alexa: I'll open a small follow-up PR to normalize the variable (`GEN_DIR`) and update all add_custom_command calls. CC @kyle for review.
kyle: thanks — pls include a small test that verifies the presence of expected stamp files after `ninja all` so this doesn't regress silently.
sam: for the bisect: suspect range is commits between `3f2a9d` and `7b8c1a` where the gen-dir rename landed. @kyle can you take the bisect since you owned that refactor?
kyle: will bisect and post results here. If anyone hits this locally, workaround is `cmake -DGEN_DIR=build/gen ..` or run the CI symlink step. I'll update by EOD.
